requirements.statement: The system must analyze customer orders, product catalogs, inventory, warehouses, suppliers, purchase orders, shipments, delivery records, product demand, transportation costs, and supplier performance data.
The system must use AI agents to analyze supply chain data and surface important decisions.
The system must provide a four-stage intelligence model: Observe, Understand, Predict, Recommend.
The system must use an Orchestrator Agent to coordinate AI agents and validate their responses.
The system must provide demand forecasting using historical demand, seasonality, and trends.
The system must analyze current inventory, turnover, safety stock, and stockout risk.
The system must evaluate supplier reliability, delivery performance, and generate a Supplier Risk Score.
The system must analyze shipment delays, delivery times, and transportation costs.
The system must detect anomalies such as unexpected demand spikes and supplier delays.
The system must generate actionable recommendations based on AI agent outputs.
The system must predict stockout risks and delivery delays.
The system must create a unified Supply Chain Risk Score and explain why it is high.
The system must perform AI-powered root cause analysis for supply chain issues.
The system must simulate supply chain scenarios to estimate impacts of changes.
The system must provide an Executive Control Tower dashboard with key supply chain metrics.
The system must provide an AI chat interface for natural language interaction.
The system must monitor data quality and provide a Data Quality Score.
The system must connect to PostgreSQL and Google Sheets for data access.

stories.title: Basic Data Integration and Analysis
stories.narrative: As a data analyst, I want the system to integrate data from customer orders, product catalogs, inventory, warehouses, suppliers, purchase orders, shipments, and delivery records, so that I can analyze the full supply chain in one place.

stories.title: Orchestrator Agent Coordination
stories.narrative: As a system auditor, I want an Orchestrator Agent to coordinate AI agents and validate their responses, so that I can trust the outputs of the intelligence system.

stories.title: Trust Spine Implementation for Data Processing
stories.narrative: As a data steward, I want a trust spine on data processing, so that I can verify the integrity of data feeding the intelligence system.

stories.title: Demand Forecasting Implementation
stories.narrative: As a supply chain manager, I want demand forecasts based on historical demand, seasonality, and trends, so that I can plan inventory and procurement proactively.

stories.title: Stockout Risk Prediction
stories.narrative: As a logistics coordinator, I want to see predicted stockout risks, so that I can reroute stock or expedite orders before a shortage happens.

stories.title: Intelligence Model Implementation
stories.narrative: As a data analyst, I want a four-stage intelligence model (Observe, Understand, Predict, Recommend), so that the system reasons through supply chain data consistently.

stories.title: Risk Detection and Anomaly Analysis
stories.narrative: As a supply chain manager, I want the system to detect anomalies such as demand spikes and supplier delays, so that I can respond before they become disruptions.

stories.title: Recommendation Generation
stories.narrative: As a supply chain manager, I want actionable recommendations generated from AI agent outputs, so that I know what action to take, not just what the data shows.

stories.title: Supplier Reliability Evaluation
stories.narrative: As a supply chain manager, I want supplier reliability scored from delivery performance, so that I can decide which suppliers to lean on and which to hedge against.

stories.title: Root Cause Analysis
stories.narrative: As a data analyst, I want AI-powered root cause analysis of supply chain issues, so that I can understand why a problem happened, not just that it happened.

stories.title: Scenario Simulation
stories.narrative: As an executive, I want to simulate supply chain scenarios, so that I can estimate the impact of a change before committing to it.

stories.title: Shipment Delay Analysis
stories.narrative: As a logistics coordinator, I want shipment delays and transportation costs analyzed, so that I can spot lanes that are consistently under-performing.

stories.title: Data Quality Monitoring
stories.narrative: As a data steward, I want a Data Quality Score across the ingested data, so that I know how much to trust what the rest of the system is showing.

stories.title: Executive Dashboard Development
stories.narrative: As an executive, I want an Executive Control Tower dashboard with key supply chain metrics, so that I can see the state of the supply chain at a glance.

stories.title: AI Chat Interface Implementation
stories.narrative: As an executive, I want an AI chat interface for natural language interaction, so that I can ask questions about the supply chain without learning a query language.
